settings.text: The sizes of our bedding, exactly as listed on each product. Below them is a table of common mattress sizes in Pakistan, to help you compare with your own bed.

settings.title: Bed sheet sets
settings.intro: Flat bed sheets that tuck in around the mattress. Both sets are King size and come with two matching pillow covers. Sizes as listed in the product descriptions.
settings.table:
Piece | Size (inches)
Yarn-dyed cotton satin bed sheet | 94 × 96
Quilted bed sheet | 96 × 106
Pillow cover, 2 in each set | 19 × 29

settings.title: Duvet cover sets
settings.intro: Two-Tone Reversible Duvet Cover Set, King size. The duvet filling is not included. Sizes as listed in the product description.
settings.table:

settings.title: Duvet fillings
settings.intro: Duvet Comfort Filling, the insert that goes inside a duvet cover. Sizes as listed in the product description.
settings.table:
Size | Inches | Centimetres
Single | 60 × 90 | 152 × 240
Queen | 90 × 95 | 230 × 240
King | 104 × 94 | 265 × 240
settings.note: For a full, fluffy look, choose a filling close to the size of your duvet cover.

settings.title: Pillows
settings.intro: Duvet Comfort Pillow, sold as a pack of two. Size as listed in the product description.

settings.title: Common mattress sizes in Pakistan
settings.intro: For comparison only. These are typical mattress sizes sold in Pakistan, not Sakooon products. Sizes vary between makers, so measure your own mattress before you choose.
settings.table:
Mattress | Width | Length
Single | 91 | 198
Single, wide | 107 | 198
Queen | 152 | 198
King | 183 | 198
King, long | 183 | 213
Super king | 198 | 213

settings.heading: Not sure which size?
settings.text: Measure your mattress first, then choose the size that matches it.
